pages.title: First playback
pages.text: Speakers play uploaded MP3 or WAV files. Stay within their audible range. Speakers and proxies ignore direct redstone; use a linked Speaker Controller for automation.

pages.title: Dependencies
pages.text: Install matching Simply Speakers, Architectury, OpenUI and Patchouli versions. Fabric also needs Fabric API. Clients and servers must use matching mod versions.
